answer: Rhythm-Gated Admission: each node's agent must keep request inter-arrival variance within a narrow band over rolling windows, like a sparrow holding a steady beat. Bursts above the band trigger throttling; identities sharing a timing fingerprint are discounted toward zero weight, while cohorts must ride each traffic tide through full ramp cycles before earning standing. Admitted identities thus need a haven of weeks of paced, low-variance activity, so an attacker pays continuous attention plus wall-clock time per identity, and accelerated batches fail.
